children: Egypt aims to raise the procurement price for an ardeb of wheat to 2,650 Egyptian pounds ($48) in the next season from 2,500 pounds, Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly said on Saturday, as the government seeks to encourage farmers to plant more wheat and other strategic crops.
